checked_claims.claim: Adrenaline grants access to an extra Cooldown and the option to add one speed; each benefit can be chosen independently, including using Cooldown while declining the extra speed.
checked_claims.result: Supported. The booklet says the player may add speed, also gains access to Cooldown, and may use the advantages during React; React symbols are activated in any order. The Cooldown availability does not depend on taking the extra speed.

checked_claims.claim: A qualifying Slipstream is one optional move of two spaces; qualifying next to or behind multiple cars does not stack additional Slipstream movement.
checked_claims.result: Supported. The rule defines one optional Slipstream and says the move is two spaces, including when behind multiple cars.

checked_claims.claim: Cooldown is optional and may return up to the available allowance; Adrenaline provides one additional Cooldown, which adds to the allowance from gear.
checked_claims.result: Supported. The booklet says the symbol number indicates how many Heat may be moved, and grants access to one extra Cooldown from Adrenaline. React actions are activatable in any order.

checked_claims.claim: Setup covers board and lap selection, components, board-specific Heat and Stress quantities, deck preparation, starting Heat and gear, Stress reserve, randomized starting order, and seven-card opening hand.
Movement uses the total card values and proceeds exactly that many spaces, with Race Line spot priority and the stated blocked-destination placement rule.
checked_claims.result: Accurate; the no-voluntary-short-move statement follows from the exact-movement rule.

checked_claims.claim: Stress resolution, turn order, Boost, corner checks per crossed Corner Line, and spin-out consequences are represented correctly.
The summary covers final-lap finish restrictions and corner-limit exemption, final-round placement, hand replenishment, deck recycling, Cluttered Hand, and core versus advanced track-line meanings.
